title: Listening Drill — Building a rain gauge — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Building a rain gauge — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on building a rain gauge. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Friday. The group will now meet on Saturday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the science foyer; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is plastic bottle. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow twenty-five minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check rim level before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed trial reading so we can offer feedback.
